evidence.section: 2. Principles and methods for alloy design
evidence.quote: Employing solution strengthening and precipitation strengthening mechanisms within the γ’ phase effectively impeded dislocation motion and facilitated the formation of stable interface structures, such as dislocation networks. These enhancements significantly bolstered the alloy ’ s ability to withstand damage and prevent failure.
